failures.detail: Implementation commit bb5bfca introduced the Campaign 17 workflow; GitHub registered it only after that push, so no run was created. CI passed; no compute consumed and no experiment started.
failures.usable_evidence: None required; the frozen diagnostics ran unchanged under the replacement trigger commit.
failures.root_cause: New-workflow registration lag on the introducing push.
failures.corrective_action: Cosmetic artifact-name fix commit 5a8ebf4 carrying the same [campaign17-diagnose] tag triggered run 38899506528, which executed the frozen matrix exactly once.
failures.rerun_justification: No completed experiment repeated; the frozen job had never started.
